item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 25/Apr/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will persist over Guangdong in the next couple of days. There will be heavy showers and squally thunderstorms over the region. With the trough of low pressure weakening early next week, showers will ease off slightly over the region. Another trough of low pressure is expected to form over central China and edge closer to the coast of southern China midweek next week. The weather will still be unsettled.
